title: Introduction to Early Care and Education

program.section_heading: Introduction to Early Care and Education Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Upon completion of the program, students will be able to explain the foundational knowledge and skills needed to work with children ages 0-five and their families in an early care and education setting.
Upon completion of the program, students will be able to summarize basic child development theories related to planning and developmentally appropriate environments and curriculum experiences.
Upon completion of the program, students will compose an application to meet licensing and workforce requirements for in home group care and education for young children in California.

notes: Noncredit program counted in hours: catalog states 'Credits listed are in hours (54 hours)' and '(Total 54)'; each course printed with 18 hours.
Course codes printed without a space (CHDVB70NC etc.); they match closed-list codes CHDV B70NC, CHDV B71NC, CHDV B72NC.
The catalog repeats 'Complete all of the following' twice (nested heading); recorded as one block.

The description also mentions 'employment as an early care and education associate teacher or higher', but as the outcome of other certificate/degree coursework, not this program; not recorded as a career. 'private business' is mentioned ambiguously and was not recorded as a career.
